18:22 Local Time, 17:22 GMT, 22:52 IST: Afghanistan have scraped their way to the finish line but with only 207 to win, they were always the fancied side in the run-chase. Gurbaz's 71-run knock at the top gave his side a head start and it was always going to be tough for Ireland to stop the visitors. The hosts kept on chipping away at the wickets but they simply didn't have enough on the board to exert constant pressure on the visitors. A number of the Afghani batters actually threw their wickets away in a bid to finish the game early. The calmness of Rashid Khan down the order ensured there were no further hiccups for Afghanistan. It got tight at the end of the innings. But Rashid held his nerves and along with Ahmadzai who put on a tough resistance, Afghanistan made their way through. The hosts bowled their hearts out but their batters led them down today. Hang on for the presentations...

Rashid Khan is the Player of the Match for his vital contributions with both bat and ball. There's an issue with his mic so we can't make out what he is exactly talking about. It has been a brilliant performance from Afghanistan's star once again

Stirling (2/2): (On Gavin Hoey and his brilliant performance) Absolutely. Look, he's been selected to do exactly that. He's a really attacking threat. To be able to bowl with that control for a wrist spinner is an unbelievable effort to start with. But also the fields that he was bowling with today, two slips, seven, two fields. To have that control at such an age, he's only going to get better and better. (On their plans for the rest of the series) Yeah, look, you've got to keep getting better. I don't think it's the whole package. We're trying to make sure that we can play 100 overs, and that's how you're going to win these games if you can put together a whole game. At the minute, we're putting blocks together, and I think we'll see improvement over the months as we go. But trying to get that into the next game in two days' time will be the tricky part.

Rahmat Shah | Afghanistan captain: (On the most pleasing part of today's performance?) Thank you. It was a low-scoring match, always tough. Finally, we won the match. (On their good bowling performance) Yeah, I give them the plans according to the field, according to the situation, and they read very well, especially Yamin Ahmadzai bowled really well, Rashid and Ghanzafar, they bowled really well too. They bowled according to the field, and especially they assessed the conditions early. (On the tricky run-chase) Of course, yes, because always a low-scoring match is very tough, and finally we won the match. (On the learnings from this game) I think the ninth-wicket partnership, Ireland did very well. Inshallah, we try to break these partnerships early if we are in a good situation on that time. Inshallah, we will try our best.
